description: Takes the list of open approvals (document, amount, approver, waiting since; optional supplier, due date, discount date and percent, approver away until, deputy). Returns the backlog per approver with number, amount and oldest age in days, flags documents red or yellow (overdue, discount expiring, waiting longer than the limit, approver away), sums the cash discount at risk, proposes remind or reroute to the deputy per person and writes a ready reminder to the person with the most urgent backlog. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

limit_days.description: Days a document may wait before it turns yellow; twice that turns it red. Default 5.

rows.description: Open approvals: document, supplier, amount, approver, since (date), due, discount_until, discount (percent), absent_until, deputy. German column names work too (Beleg, Betrag, Freigeber, Seit, Fällig, Skonto bis, Abwesend bis, Vertretung).

name: check_approval_backlog
title: Approval backlog radar: who is holding which invoice or order, how long, which discounts are at risk, and whom to reroute to
